title: LuckRead D1-02 Neon PostgreSQL Schema Source Inventory Contract

owners.role: Authoritative content/article/post/video schema and content lifecycle
Authoritative social graph, interactions, discussions, notifications and push-delivery schema

physicalBindings.reason: Separate governance/platform domain; explicitly excluded from the D1-02 source and migration inventory.

knownHistoricalContractPathDiscrepancies.disposition: The current W05-social file is inventoried as the repository source. The legacy path is not read or executed.

portabilityReviewRequirements.requiredReview: Map JSON construction/extraction to PostgreSQL JSON/JSONB functions while preserving the existing serialized payload contract.
Replace SQLite randomblob identifier generation with a PostgreSQL-supported generator and preserve identifier uniqueness/format guarantees.
Port each trigger to an explicit PostgreSQL trigger function and verify same-transaction outbox/notification semantics.
Translate conflict suppression to ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING only after verifying the exact unique/conflict target and idempotency semantics.
Replace create-copy-drop-rename patterns with reviewed PostgreSQL ALTER TABLE operations; never replay SQLite rebuild SQL blindly.
Separately audit D1Database.batch, change-count guards, query result shapes and transaction ownership before any Worker runtime adapter migration.

executionOrder: Freeze W03 and W05 D1-02 source inventories and physical binding ownership
Review every SQLite-specific migration construct and record PostgreSQL translation decisions
Create PostgreSQL-native D1-02 migration artifacts under the owning Worker boundaries
Run targeted SQL/static checks and a fresh PostgreSQL 18 local bootstrap with schema/constraint/index/trigger assertions
Run all applicable W03 and W05 tests against the PostgreSQL-native artifacts
Only after a separately reviewed PR and green CI, consider the D1-02 schema-only Neon apply under its own exact release gate
safetyInvariants: Do not execute any SQLite/D1 migration file against PostgreSQL.
Do not inspect, mutate or apply DDL to Neon in this source-inventory slice.
Do not mutate Cloudflare D1 or deploy/change W03/W05 Worker bindings.
Do not import accounts, content, media, social relationships, notifications or other business rows.
Do not include W05's D1-03 binding or D1-03-owned records in D1-02 migration artifacts.
Do not add cross-domain foreign keys or distributed transactions.
Do not add Workers, D1 databases, Queues or Service Bindings.
Do not claim PostgreSQL runtime compatibility or production cutover from a source inventory report.
